theme: 3 terms on flexible function parameters: a preset value, any number of values and changing the caller's variable

terms.definition: A parameter that has a preset value, used when the caller passes nothing for it.
terms.example: Use default parameters so callers can skip values that rarely change.

terms.definition: A parameter that accepts zero or more values of the same type, written with three dots after the type.
terms.example: Use variadic parameters so we can pass any number of scores.

terms.definition: A parameter that lets a function change the caller's variable, marked with `inout`.
terms.example: Use in-out parameters when the function must update the caller's variable.

video.title: Default, Variadic & In-Out Parameters | iOS Daily English Day 24
video.description:
Learn to talk about flexible Swift functions: Default Parameter, Variadic Parameter & In-Out Parameter, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Default Parameter - A parameter that has a preset value, used when the caller passes nothing for it.
Variadic Parameter - A parameter that accepts zero or more values of the same type, written with three dots after the type.
In-Out Parameter - A parameter that lets a function change the caller's variable, marked with `inout`.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Day 24 of the iOS Daily English series: 3 terms a day, from Swift basics to advanced iOS.

landscape.title: Swift Default, Variadic & In-Out Parameters in English | Day 24
landscape.description:
Explain Default Parameter, Variadic Parameter & In-Out Parameter in Swift by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
기본 매개변수, 가변 매개변수, 입출력 매개변수 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Default Parameter - A parameter that has a preset value, used when the caller passes nothing for it.
한국어: 기본 매개변수: 호출할 때 값을 넘기지 않으면 미리 정해 둔 값을 쓰는 매개변수

Variadic Parameter - A parameter that accepts zero or more values of the same type, written with three dots after the type.
한국어: 가변 매개변수: 같은 타입의 값을 0개 이상 받을 수 있는 매개변수

In-Out Parameter - A parameter that lets a function change the caller's variable, marked with `inout`.
한국어: 입출력 매개변수: 함수가 호출한 쪽의 변수를 직접 바꿀 수 있게 하는 매개변수

dialogue.title: Flexible functions in a chat

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Mina, my `add` function takes an array of `points`. Every call needs brackets.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Make `points` a Variadic Parameter. Just write three dots after `Int`.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So with a Variadic Parameter, I can pass one, five, or nothing?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Right. Inside, `points` is still an array.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Nice. Also, most calls pass zero for `bonus`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Then make `bonus` a Default Parameter, set to zero.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Hmm, I think a Default Parameter hides too much from the reader.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Not here. Zero is the normal case.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Fair. One more problem, my `total` never changes after the call.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Make `score` an In-Out Parameter. It writes the new value back.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Got it. Variadic Parameter for many values, Default Parameter to skip one, In-Out Parameter to update mine.
Use default parameters so callers can skip rare values.
